BUILT AROUND STATE-OF-THE-ART PROPLEX ELECTRONICS, THESE DEVICES ENSURE LONG-TERM PERFORMANCE IN EVEN THE WORST RAINY OR DUSTY CONDITIONS. more GBS Network Switches IQ Ethernet-DMX Nodes Opto-Splitters LTC DEVICES ProPlex MANAGER DMX Controllers Testers Drives and DIN Rail Devices Accessories Suggested Packages Rock Solid Blue Used by AV and entertainment professionals around the world, ProPlex Cables, Drives, Devices, Software, Switches and Tools are designed to help the modern entertainment/AV technician with even the most challenging and complex tasks. ProPlex technology is proven to be rock solid; rugged and reliable, performing flawlessly in extreme conditions, again and again and again. Simply Intuitive The ProPlex family of data distribution devices and drives features uniquely intuitive operating systems that maximize simplicity and accessibility for the user. We are committed to providing state-of-the-art, powerful products, with the understanding that, in most applications, simplicity of use is critically important. A prime ProPlex design criteria therefore is to make operation easier for both the on-site technician, and for their support team back at HQ. This real-world approach simplifies the most complex challenges, and provides a turnkey solution for A/V and entertainment professionals at any level.
